scope_notes: Unprofiled token latency includes runner embedding/output checks; first logits and setup are excluded.
Diagnostic worker time, interval coverage, native operator wall and unprofiled token latency have different scopes.
Within-process case order and thermal frequency caps materially confound raw history-length slopes; preserve both rounds.
Native uses packed-dynamic FC and padded/aligned attention; YNN uses static QAT and real query/history extents.
The new argmax check establishes self-consistency only; no execution graph, weights or numerical policy changed.
Before/after frequency snapshots and battery temperatures are not execution-window CPU measurements.
